reference_sql:
WITH customer_channels AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_orders,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_mix AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
    CASE WHEN store_orders > 0 AND web_orders > 0 THEN 'both' WHEN store_orders > 0 THEN 'store only' ELSE 'web only' END AS channel_mix
  FROM customer_channels
)
SELECT channel_mix, COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM customer_mix
GROUP BY channel_mix
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS n_channels, MIN(channel) AS one_channel FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT CASE WHEN n_channels = 2 THEN 'both' WHEN one_channel = 'store' THEN 'store only' ELSE 'web only' END AS channel_mix, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM c GROUP BY 1

WITH customer_channels AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_orders FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT CASE WHEN store_orders > 0 AND web_orders > 0 THEN 'both' WHEN store_orders > 0 THEN 'store only' ELSE 'web only' END AS channel_mix, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM customer_channels GROUP BY CASE WHEN store_orders > 0 AND web_orders > 0 THEN 'both' WHEN store_orders > 0 THEN 'store only' ELSE 'web only' END

other_way.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS n_channels, MIN(channel) AS one_channel FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT CASE WHEN n_channels = 2 THEN 'both' WHEN one_channel = 'store' THEN 'store only' ELSE 'web only' END AS channel_mix, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM c GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Counting different channels and naming one with MIN is shorter, but two separate counts state each case more plainly.

solver.query:
WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END) AS store_orders,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 END) AS web_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_orders > 0 AND web_orders > 0 THEN 'both'
            WHEN store_orders > 0 THEN 'store only'
            ELSE 'web only' END AS channel_mix,
       COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM per_customer
GROUP BY 1
